title: Paul H Probable NDEs 4549 NDE 4549
content: 1954, 1997 - Both experience of void and reaching incredible light, all colors, almost to boundary line. Experiences later, e.g. 1974, sudden access to every book I've ever read, many human languages, whatever search terms, photographic - then whoosh-like feeling, back-into-body, seated near four other people, talking, who did not notice that I had 'been gone'. Joined core contactee group in Washington DC-metro area, 1997-2000, after inpatient bone marrow ward experience; Curious to note how few writings connect pre-death dream literature of Martin Luther King, Jr., or of Mohandas Gandhi (nearly killed numerous times).

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Illness 3 genetically-related sisters and 1 genetically-related brother dead before I reached age 5 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' In 1954, the doctors expected me to die as had all four genetically-related siblings. In 1997, the doctors did not necessarily expect me to live. Told in 1998 I had five years to live, statistically, by Hematology Div. Head, NHLBI, Bethesda MD.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Uncertain I lost awareness of my body

elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control 1974, especially, total recall - like so-called Akashic libraries.
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future Future travel, conversations bridged by NDE memories.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
